description: Defines the AudioWatchdog class and related structures for monitoring audio thread performance, including CPU availability and underruns, within the Android audio system.

classes.name: AudioWatchdog
classes.description: A thread class that periodically monitors CPU availability and underruns in the Android audio system.

classes.name: AudioWatchdogDump
classes.description: A structure that caches statistics related to audio underruns and logs, which can be dumped for diagnostics.

methods.name: requestExit
methods.description: Requests the watchdog thread to exit.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Suspends the watchdog thread from execution.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Allows the watchdog thread to continue execution.

methods.name: setDump
methods.description: Sets the dump structure where statistics are stored.

methods.name: threadLoop
methods.description: Main loop of the watchdog thread, performing periodic checks.
